$comment: Mdigital frontend library whitelist/blacklist — the single source of truth for every skill in this pack. Categories: data, ui, ux, forms, validation, state, errors, i18n, architecture, tooling. Anything not listed: ask the user before installing.

allowed.name: @tanstack/react-query
allowed.use_for: All client-side server state: queries, mutations, cache, invalidation, prefetch, infinite lists (v5 only)
allowed.reason: Single cache with dedupe, stale-while-revalidate, retries, AbortSignal cancellation, Suspense and SSR hydration

allowed.name: @tanstack/react-query-devtools
allowed.reason: Official devtools; tree-shaken from production builds

allowed.name: @tanstack/eslint-plugin-query
allowed.reason: exhaustive-deps catches variables missing from query keys; flags unstable QueryClient and other misuse

allowed.name: fetch (native) via src/shared/api/http.ts
allowed.reason: No dependency, native AbortSignal, works in browser, Node and Next.js Server Components; one wrapper adds base URL, JSON, typed ApiError and Zod parsing

allowed.name: zod
allowed.use_for: Validating every API response at the boundary and inferring TS types
allowed.reason: Backend drift fails loudly as a contract ApiError instead of crashing deep in the UI; one schema = one type

allowed.name: openapi-typescript + openapi-fetch
allowed.use_for: Projects whose backend publishes an OpenAPI spec
allowed.reason: Generated types with zero runtime cost; fetchers stay in features/<f>/api and feed queryOptions

allowed.name: @tanstack/react-router loaders (ensureQueryData / prefetchQuery)
allowed.reason: Starts requests before render, removes loading waterfalls, reuses the same queryOptions

allowed.name: Next.js Server Components + HydrationBoundary/dehydrate
allowed.use_for: Server prefetch in Next.js App Router
allowed.reason: Official TanStack Query SSR pattern; streams pending queries to the client cache

allowed.name: msw
allowed.use_for: Mocking the network in unit/integration tests, Storybook and local dev
allowed.reason: Tests run real fetchers, schemas and cache logic; no hook mocks

allowed.name: shadcn/ui (CLI)
allowed.reason: Team-owned source, Tailwind-native, accessible

allowed.name: @base-ui/react or radix-ui
allowed.use_for: Headless layer under shadcn; one per project
allowed.reason: Accessible behaviour; follow whichever the project already uses

allowed.name: tailwindcss v4 + tw-animate-css
allowed.reason: Design tokens via @theme; tw-animate-css replaces tailwindcss-animate

allowed.name: class-variance-authority
allowed.reason: Replaces boolean props and conditional class soup

allowed.name: cn (or clsx + tailwind-merge) via @/shared/lib/utils
allowed.reason: Single entry point, implementation swappable

allowed.name: lucide-react
allowed.reason: shadcn default, consistent stroke style

allowed.name: sonner
allowed.reason: shadcn default, accessible live region, toast.promise and Undo

allowed.name: next-themes
allowed.reason: Standard shadcn dark-mode setup

allowed.name: recharts, @tanstack/react-table, vaul, cmdk, embla-carousel-react, react-day-picker, input-otp
allowed.reason: Pulled in by shadcn

allowed.name: @tanstack/react-virtual
allowed.reason: Keeps INP low

allowed.name: react-hook-form + @hookform/resolvers
allowed.reason: Single form stack; uncontrolled, fast

allowed.name: zod (v4)
allowed.use_for: API responses, forms, route search params
allowed.reason: One schema = one type; Zod 4 syntax only

allowed.name: @tanstack/react-router validateSearch
allowed.reason: Typed search params with Zod defaults

allowed.name: nuqs
allowed.use_for: URL state in Next.js App Router
allowed.reason: Typed parsers, shallow updates

allowed.name: react-error-boundary (v6)
allowed.reason: resetKeys, useErrorBoundary, QueryErrorResetBoundary support

allowed.name: @sentry/react / @sentry/nextjs
allowed.reason: Official React 19 root handlers and Next.js onRequestError

allowed.name: typescript-eslint (strict)
allowed.reason: Strict TS is the team baseline

allowed.name: eslint-plugin-react-hooks (v6+)
allowed.use_for: Rules of Hooks and React Compiler purity rules
allowed.reason: Official React lint rules

allowed.name: babel-plugin-react-compiler / Next reactCompiler
allowed.reason: New code needs no manual useMemo/useCallback/memo

allowed.name: eslint-plugin-import-x + eslint-import-resolver-typescript
allowed.reason: Enforces shared -> features -> pages -> app

allowed.name: eslint-plugin-react (selected rules)
allowed.reason: Enforces one component per file

allowed.name: Storybook (optional)
allowed.reason: Visual catalogue of shared pieces

allowed.name: react-i18next
allowed.use_for: All user-facing copy, even with one UI language
allowed.reason: ErrorState, getUserMessage and form errors rely on one i18n instance; adding a language later costs nothing

allowed.name: msw-storybook-addon
allowed.reason: Same network mocks as tests

allowed.name: @fontsource-variable/* (Vite) / next/font (Next.js)
allowed.reason: No third-party font requests; no layout shift

allowed.name: eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y
allowed.reason: Catches missing labels and alt text at lint time

allowed.name: @storybook/addon-a11y
allowed.use_for: Accessibility checks of shared/ui and shared/components stories
allowed.reason: axe checks per story

allowed.name: @sentry/vite-plugin
allowed.use_for: Uploading hidden source maps in Vite builds
allowed.reason: Readable stack traces without shipping source maps

conditional.name: axios
conditional.when: Only in an existing project that already depends on it, and only inside src/shared/api/
conditional.reason: Works (supports AbortSignal) but adds weight and a second interceptor/retry layer; new projects use native fetch

conditional.name: ky
conditional.when: Only if the project already uses it, inside src/shared/api/, with ky retry disabled
conditional.reason: Thin fetch wrapper; its retry would duplicate TanStack Query retries

conditional.name: @hey-api/openapi-ts
conditional.when: OpenAPI backend and the team wants generated Zod schemas or queryOptions
conditional.reason: Good generator, but generated hooks must not replace the feature key factory and invalidation conventions

conditional.name: orval
conditional.when: OpenAPI backend; configure it to emit fetchers/Zod schemas (or queryOptions), not standalone hooks
conditional.reason: Generated hooks own their key scheme and bypass features/<f>/api factories

conditional.name: Next.js Server Actions
conditional.when: Next.js App Router mutations; used as mutationFn or for simple forms with no client cache
conditional.reason: Fine transport, but Query keys must still be invalidated on the client; revalidatePath/updateTag only for RSC-rendered data

conditional.name: React 19 use(promise)
conditional.when: Next.js only, for a promise created in a Server Component and passed to a Client Component
conditional.reason: A promise created during client render suspends forever; use useSuspenseQuery on the client

conditional.name: Next.js 'use cache' / cacheLife / cacheTag
conditional.when: Server-side caching of data rendered only by Server Components
conditional.reason: Server cache layer, independent of the TanStack Query client cache; do not render the same data both ways

conditional.name: @tanstack/query-persist-client-core / react-query-persist-client
conditional.reason: Persists the Query cache correctly (buster, maxAge); never hand-roll localStorage caching

conditional.name: graphql-request or typed fetch + GraphQL codegen (TypedDocumentNode)
conditional.reason: Keeps TanStack Query as the only cache instead of adding Apollo/urql

conditional.name: zustand
conditional.when: Truly global client-only UI state that URL, context and the query cache cannot hold
conditional.reason: Last resort; never holds server data

conditional.name: motion (motion/react)
conditional.when: Gestures, layout transitions, sequenced animation only; must respect useReducedMotion()
conditional.reason: Plain CSS/Tailwind covers simple hovers and fades

conditional.name: Sentry Session Replay
conditional.when: Only with maskAllText and blockAllMedia plus a privacy sign-off

conditional.name: eslint-plugin-boundaries
conditional.when: The team wants stricter feature isolation than import-x provides

conditional.name: superjson
conditional.when: Next.js dehydrate/hydrate when query data contains Date, Map or Set
conditional.reason: Plain JSON loses these types across the server/client boundary

forbidden.name: fetch/axios inside useEffect with useState
forbidden.instead: useQuery / useSuspenseQuery with queryOptions from features/<f>/api
forbidden.reason: Race conditions, no cache or dedupe, no cancellation, double requests in StrictMode, manual loading/error state

forbidden.name: Copying server data into useState, Zustand, Redux, Jotai or Context
forbidden.instead: Read from the query (with select) and derive during render; client stores hold UI state only
forbidden.reason: Creates a second source of truth that goes stale after refetch or invalidation

forbidden.name: swr
forbidden.reason: A second cache next to TanStack Query; weaker mutation and optimistic rollback story

forbidden.name: @reduxjs/toolkit/query (RTK Query)
forbidden.reason: Requires a Redux store the stack does not use; second cache

forbidden.name: @apollo/client, urql
forbidden.instead: TanStack Query + graphql-request / typed GraphQL documents
forbidden.reason: Second, normalized cache with its own invalidation model

forbidden.name: react-query (v3 package) and @tanstack/react-query v4 APIs
forbidden.reason: Removed overloads, cacheTime and isLoading semantics changed; mixing versions breaks types

forbidden.name: node-fetch, isomorphic-fetch, cross-fetch, whatwg-fetch
forbidden.reason: Native fetch exists in every runtime we target (modern browsers, Node 18+, Next.js)

forbidden.name: superagent, request, jquery.ajax, use-http, react-fetch-hook, react-async
forbidden.reason: Unmaintained or duplicate abstractions without a proper cache

forbidden.name: setInterval / setTimeout polling
forbidden.reason: Leaks on unmount, ignores visibility and dedupe

forbidden.name: localStorage/sessionStorage as a server-data cache
forbidden.instead: TanStack Query cache (persist plugin if offline is required)
forbidden.reason: No staleness, invalidation or schema versioning

forbidden.name: Inline query key literals in components
forbidden.instead: Feature key factory + queryOptions in features/<f>/api/*.queries.ts
forbidden.reason: Keys drift and invalidation silently misses entries

forbidden.name: Type assertions on responses (res.json() as T, as any)
forbidden.reason: Lies to the type checker; backend changes crash at runtime far from the cause

forbidden.name: Fetching without forwarding the AbortSignal
forbidden.reason: Stale responses waste bandwidth and cannot be cancelled when the key changes

forbidden.name: MUI / Material UI
forbidden.reason: Own theme system and emotion styling engine, fights Tailwind

forbidden.name: Chakra UI, Mantine, Ant Design
forbidden.reason: Second component kit and theming system

forbidden.name: Bootstrap / react-bootstrap
forbidden.reason: Global CSS clashes with Tailwind preflight

forbidden.name: styled-components, Emotion
forbidden.reason: Runtime CSS-in-JS, poor RSC fit; styled-components in maintenance mode

forbidden.name: CSS Modules / Sass for component styling
forbidden.reason: Second styling path

forbidden.name: DaisyUI, Flowbite and other Tailwind kits
forbidden.reason: Parallel component classes and tokens

forbidden.name: react-icons, FontAwesome, Heroicons, MUI icons
forbidden.instead: lucide-react (custom SVG in shared/ui/icons if missing)
forbidden.reason: One icon set only

forbidden.name: framer-motion (old package name)
forbidden.reason: Superseded by motion

forbidden.name: GSAP, react-spring, anime.js
forbidden.reason: Overlap; needs explicit lead approval

forbidden.name: tailwindcss-animate
forbidden.reason: Replaced in shadcn for Tailwind v4

forbidden.name: Tailwind @apply for repeated class strings
forbidden.instead: Extract a component or a cva variant
forbidden.reason: Hides tokens and duplicates styles

forbidden.name: react-hot-toast, react-toastify, shadcn legacy useToast
forbidden.reason: Duplicate toast channel; shadcn deprecated its old toast

forbidden.name: react-loading-skeleton
forbidden.reason: Duplicate of a primitive we own

forbidden.name: react-spinners and other spinner packs
forbidden.instead: lucide Loader2 with animate-spin under motion-safe
forbidden.reason: Unneeded dependency

forbidden.name: window.confirm and hand-made modals
forbidden.reason: No focus trap or styling; inaccessible

forbidden.name: formik, react-final-form, TanStack Form
forbidden.reason: Two form stacks in one codebase

forbidden.name: yup, joi, valibot (in app code)
forbidden.reason: One validation library

forbidden.name: use-query-params, hand-written URLSearchParams sync
forbidden.reason: Untyped

forbidden.name: Redux, Redux Toolkit, MobX, Recoil (new projects)
forbidden.instead: TanStack Query + URL + RHF + context + zustand
forbidden.reason: Every case is already covered; extra boilerplate

forbidden.name: neverthrow, fp-ts, effect (for error handling)
forbidden.instead: ApiError + plain TS Result union where needed
forbidden.reason: Second error model next to TanStack Query

forbidden.name: Hand-written class error boundaries
forbidden.reason: Reinvents tested behaviour

forbidden.name: Sentry.ErrorBoundary together with root reactErrorHandler
forbidden.instead: react-error-boundary for UI, reporting at the root
forbidden.reason: Errors get reported twice

forbidden.name: Custom window.onerror / unhandledrejection listeners
forbidden.reason: Already captured by Sentry

forbidden.name: console.log as logging
forbidden.reason: no-console is an error in CI

forbidden.name: forwardRef in new code
forbidden.reason: Obsolete API

forbidden.name: React.FC
forbidden.reason: Adds implicit children and noise

forbidden.name: react-use / ahooks lifecycle hooks (useMount, useUpdateEffect)
forbidden.instead: Plain useEffect with correct dependencies, or no effect
forbidden.reason: Hide dependencies from the linter

forbidden.name: Barrel files under shared/ and any export *
forbidden.instead: Import concrete modules; feature index.ts with named re-exports
forbidden.reason: Import cycles and slow dev builds
